statements.status_notes: Memory leak in the xmllint interactive shell when the input line contains only whitespace. The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream fix for rebuilt r2 (3.23) and r3 (3.24) releases; stock Alpine PURLs remain under investigation until consumers pick up the DHI rebuild. Reference: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-1757

Stack buffer overflows in the xmlcatalog interactive shell (--shell) usershell() parser in upstream Alpine libxml2 2.13.9 packages. The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream fix for rebuilt r2 (3.23) and r3 (3.24) releases; stock Alpine PURLs remain under investigation until consumers pick up the DHI rebuild.

CVE-2026-0989 is uncontrolled recursion in the RelaxNG external-schema inclusion parser, fixed upstream in libxml2 2.15.2. Alpine 3.x ships libxml2 2.13.9; backporting the RelaxNG recursion-depth fix to 2.13.x is not practical. DHI catalog images use libxml2 as a general-purpose XML library and do not document RelaxNG schema validation on untrusted RelaxNG inputs as a supported runtime path.

Uncontrolled recursion in xmlParseSGMLCatalog is reachable only when a local user parses an untrusted SGML catalog with the xmlcatalog CLI. Both Debian (unimportant) and upstream consider this negligible. The upstream recursion-depth fix targets libxml2 2.15 catalog.c and does not apply to the 2.13.x source without invasive changes for a negligible CLI-only issue. Reference: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8732

The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream xmllint interactive shell memory-leak fix from https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/160c8a43ba37dfb07ebe6446fbad9d0973d9279d as dhi-cve-2026-1757-shell-cmdline-leak.patch. Upstream fixes this in shell.c (>= 2.14); on the 2.13.9 source the interactive shell loop still lives in debugXML.c as xmlShell(), and the patch frees cmdline before continuing on whitespace-only input. Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-1757

The DHI libxml2 APK backports the upstream xmlcatalog --shell overflow fix from https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/commit/c2e233fc1b341685fc99621b2768b503f777a72e as dhi-cve-2026-11979-xmlcatalog-shell-overflow.patch, which bounds the fixed-size command, arg and argv stack buffers in usershell(). Tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-11979

Integer underflow and heap out-of-bounds read in berval2tl_data() in the LDAP KDB backend plugin (plugins/kdb/ldap/libkdb_ldap/ldap_principal2.c). Triggering requires a KDC or kadmind configured with an LDAP database backend whose backend returns a krbExtraData attribute with bv_len < 2; that data originates from the trusted KDB datastore, not from an external Kerberos protocol client, so it cannot be controlled by an adversary. Debian marks this unimportant (bug 1139821) with no security impact and notes it does not cross any security boundary.
